# Katana ZERO Archipelago Multiworld — v0.1.0 (Early Alpha Preview)

> [!WARNING]
> ### ⚠️ Early Alpha & Development Disclaimer
> This is an **initial early-access alpha release (v0.1.0)** of the Katana ZERO Archipelago integration.
> While the core multiworld logic, stage unlocks, memory reader, live client hooks, and combat systems have undergone extensive testing, **this project is still in an early state and bugs, desyncs, or unexpected game engine quirks may occur.**
>
> - **Save Data:** The client interacts with the game in memory without permanently modifying your vanilla game files on disk. However, as standard precaution for any game mod/randomizer, backing up your local save directory (`%LOCALAPPDATA%/Katana_ZERO/`) is recommended.
> - **Bug Reports & Feedback:** If you encounter unexpected behavior, crashes, or logic issues, please submit an issue on the [GitHub Issue Tracker](https://github.com/CheeserLPC/Archipelago-KatanaZero/issues).

---

## What's Included in This Release

### Multiworld Progression & Logic
- **VHS Stage Tapes (11 Items):** Progression is gated by stage tapes. Unlocking a tape opens access to that chapter in level select and throughout playthroughs.
- **Combat Mechanic Shards (2 Items):** Build your moveset! Throwing (`Strength Training`) and slow-motion (`Chronos`) are independent progression items.
- **Government Lab Keys (5 Items):** Prism, Phoenix, Savant, Master, and Prototype Keys hidden across the multiworld to breach the Government Lab doors.
- **Swords Shuffle (5 Useful Items):** Find the Prism Sword, Phoenix Blade, Savant Blade, Master Sword, and Claymore Prototype scattered across the world.
- **Enemysanity (487 Check Locations):** Optional mode where every single non-boss enemy in the game holds an item check that is immediately sent upon neutralizing them.
- **3 Configurable Goals:**
  - `government_lab`: Collect all 5 master keys and clear the Government Lab.
  - `all_tapes`: Collect and complete all 11 stage tapes.
  - `boss_rush`: Defeat all 4 major bosses (Mr. V, Kissyface, Headhunter, Psychiatrist).

###  Combat Traps (7 Unique Types)
When rolled into filler item slots, receiving a trap triggers an instant combat challenge:
- **Chronos Overdose:** Inverts left and right movement controls for 15 seconds.
- **Freeze Trap:** Freezes the player in place for 3 seconds.
- **Chronos Disruptor:** Disables slow-motion for 15 seconds.
- **Screen Flip:** Inverts the game camera upside-down for 15 seconds.
- **Spatial Warp:** Teleports the player back to the stage room spawn point.
- **Roll Disruptor:** Disables dodge rolling for 15 seconds.
- **Pacifist Trap:** Disables sword slashes and throwing for 5 seconds.
- *Trap Safety:* Traps are automatically queued during room transitions, cutscenes, and stage clear screens, only triggering once active combat gameplay stabilizes.

###  Thematic DeathLink
- Real-time DeathLink synchronization across the multiworld.
- Broadcasts randomized Katana ZERO-flavored death messages (e.g., *"{player} ran out of Chronos."*, *"{player} brought a katana to an automatic rifle fight."*, *"{player} suffered from severe Chronos withdrawal."*).
- Configurable **DeathLink Amnesty** (`death_link_amnesty`) allowing a threshold of free deaths before broadcasting a signal.

###  In-Memory Audio Randomizer
- **Randomize Music:** Shuffles 47 background music tracks across all stages, cutscenes, and boss fights.
- **Randomize Sound Effects:** Shuffles over 440 sound effects in Audio Group 0 for pure chaos.
- **Loop Protection:** Dynamic inline assembly hook prevents pause sounds, VHS tape sounds, and ambient loops from infinitely repeating.
- **Zero Disk Overhead:** Leaves your game `.ogg` files and `data.win` 100% vanilla and untouched.

###  Engine Stability & Bug Safeguards
- **YYGetReal Safe Fallback:** Global engine hook at `0x018DDAB0` prevents GameMaker YYC native type assertion crashes (`REAL argument incorrect type`), gracefully returning `0.0`.
- **Bunker Headhunter Boss Fight Fix:** Native patch at `0x00486B12` safeguards against energy bullet collision memory reallocation, eliminating the `player_hurt` line 330 crash.

###  Archipelago Launcher Integration
- Includes `Components.py` registering **"Katana ZERO Client"** directly into the Archipelago Launcher.
- Automatic process detection and attachment to `Katana ZERO.exe` with terminal connection banners and auto-rehooking if the game is restarted.

---

## Installation & Setup

1. **Download `katana_zero.apworld`** from the Assets below.
2. Place `katana_zero.apworld` in your Archipelago installation's `custom_worlds/` folder.
3. Start or restart the **Archipelago Launcher**.
4. Generate a YAML configuration from **"Generate Template Settings"** -> **"Katana ZERO"**.
5. Launch **Katana ZERO**.
6. In the Archipelago Launcher, click **"Katana ZERO Client"** and connect to your Archipelago room.

---
